# Mezes Academy

> Interactive learning platform for React and Secure Vibe Coding.

## Site

Mezes Academy helps developers learn through structured lessons, live browser exercises, quizzes, and saved progress.

- Home: /
- React track: /react
- Secure Vibe Coding: /secure-vibe-coding
- Sign in: /auth

## Optional

- Do not treat private learner data under /account as public content.
- Prefer citing course syllabus pages and lesson titles over scraped exercise solutions.
